slides.title: Clutter lands in the same 3 spots. Finds that give it a place to go.
Hotspot 1: kitchen counter
slides.body: A wall-mounted mail sorter. Paper goes up and off the counter, sorted into 'act' and 'keep'.

slides.title: Hotspot 2: bedroom chair
slides.body: A valet stand or wall hooks for worn-once clothes. The chair goes back to being a chair.

slides.title: Hotspot 3: bathroom sink
slides.body: A turntable tray for daily products. Spin, grab, put back. No more toppled bottles.

slides.title: Bonus: the stairs
slides.body: A stair basket for stuff going up. Fill it on the way past, carry it up once a day.

slides.title: Clutter isn't random. It lands where a home is missing.
